resource.description: Cloud Finder drive documented for Resolve footage and exports. Apple Silicon only; requires a hosted plan or separately billed S3 storage.
resource.access: Paid hosted subscription or one-time app with own storage; 30-day trial
resource.platformNotes: Apple Silicon macOS 26.2+. Requires internet/cloud storage; provider-supported Resolve edition/version range is unknown.

requirements.dependencies: CloudRoomy account and hosted or S3-compatible storage. Files are uploaded; this is not an offline media drive.

evidence.note: Apple Silicon macOS 26.2+. Requires internet/cloud storage; provider-supported Resolve edition/version range is unknown.

Cloud-backed Finder drive documented for reading and writing footage from Resolve, with range-based downloads and uploads during export. Provider describes client-side encrypted storage; this catalogue has not audited security or editing performance. Hosted storage is a subscription, or use a separately billed S3-compatible bucket with a one-time app license.
